summary: Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch 1.12.1 and TensorFlow 2.9.1 inference. With an explicit version, retrieve() returns the expected URIs: pytorch-inference-graviton:1.12.1-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04-sagemaker and tensorflow-inference-graviton:2.9.1-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04-sagemaker. Changes are in src/sagemaker/image_uris.py (GRAVITON_FAMILIES, graviton processor selection, graviton repo/registry/container_version handling, tag uses cpu, falls back to cpu for versions without a Graviton image) and in image_uri_config/pytorch.json and tensorflow.json (graviton processor, 1.12.1 / 2.9.1 inference entries with graviton sub-entries, 1.12.1 / 2.9.1 training entries, 2.9 alias). Tests: test_pytorch.py 975 passed; test_dlc_frameworks.py and image_uris/test_retrieve.py 534 passed. Not run: full unit suite. Caveats: the spec's example calls omit version and still raise ValueError, as for any multi-version framework; Graviton region registries are unverified (assumed same account as standard entries); training entries for 1.12.1 and 2.9.1 were added beyond the spec to keep test fixtures consistent. Test run needed a temporary mock shim at /tmp/mockshim because the shared venv lacks the mock package. Nothing committed.
